Interview Template for Non-English Speaking Candidates:

Section 1: Introduction
Greeting the interviewer and introducing yourself briefly

For Interview 1:
"Good afternoon, my name is [Your Name]. I am currently working as a [Your Position] at [Company Name]. I have been in this role for [Number of Years] years and I am eager to leverage my experience to help your organization succeed. 

For Interview 2:
"Hello, I am [Your Name]. I have worked in the [Industry/Field] field for [Number of Years] years. In my last role, I was responsible for [Responsibilities], and I am excited to bring my experience and skills to your organization."

Section 2: Experience Overview
Briefly summarizing your professional experience and relevant skills

For Interview 1:
"In my previous role, I [Key Responsibilities and Achievements]. I also developed [Skills or Projects] which I believe are valuable to your organization. I am proficient in [Skills or Tools], and I am eager to contribute to your team.

For Interview 2:
"I have a strong background in [Industry/Field]. My experience includes managing [Key Responsibilities] and developing [Skills or Projects]. I am proficient in [Skills or Tools], and I believe my experience would be beneficial to your organization."

Section 3: English Proficiency
Discussing your English language skills and their relevance to the job

For Interview 1:
"I have been working in [Country] for the past [Number of Years] years, where I have used English for [Percentage]% of my communication. I am confident in my ability to communicate effectively in English, and I am eager to further develop my skills."

For Interview 2:
"I have been working in [Country] for the past [Number of Years] years, and I have used English for [Percentage]% of my communication. I am confident in my ability to communicate effectively in English, and I am eager to further develop my skills."

Section 4: Questioning
Ask the interviewer questions to show your interest in the role and the company

For Interview 1:
"Could you please tell me more about the daily responsibilities of this role? I am eager to understand how I can contribute to the team.

For Interview 2:
"I am interested in learning more about the company's long-term goals and how this role fits into that vision. Could you please provide more information about the company's growth plans?

Section 5: Confirmation
Ask if there are any additional questions or concerns the interviewer would like to discuss before making an offer

For Interview 1:
"I would like to confirm my interest in this role. Is there any additional information or feedback you would like to provide before we make an offer?"

For Interview 2:
"I am excited about this opportunity. Is there any additional information or feedback you would like to provide before we make an offer?"

Good luck with your interviews!
